title: SourceTrace evidence index
description: Everything extracted from the source images in stage 2: the list of sources (one per image) and the evidence items findings cite. Cross-references (unique IDs, matching pages) are checked by validate_evidence.py.

source_id.description: The image file name without extension, as assigned by validate_input.py.

path.description: Path of the image, as given to validate_input.py.
